mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may increase serum valproate levels by reducing renal clearance and altering fluid/electrolyte balance, while valproate can cause hyponatremia that may be exacerbated by thiazide-induced hyponatremia.
action: Monitor serum valproate concentrations and sodium levels regularly; adjust valproate dosing if needed and consider alternative antihypertensive if hyponatremia develops.
